old.upper_limit_notes: A safety upper limit is not established by these trials. PMID 31221944 used 500 mg BioCell twice daily (1000 mg/day) for 12 weeks; wrinkles/elasticity signals did not include improved skin-surface water content or retention. old.upper_limit_notes: A safety upper limit is not established by these citations. PMID 18350281 studied acute S.officinalis standardized extract167/333/666/1332 mg in20 older adults, with333 mg strongest signal. PMID 12895685 studied S.lavandulaefolia essential oil25–150 microliters in young adults, with50 microliters word-recall signal. No common300–600 mg leaf-extract threshold or600 mg safety ceiling is established. Essential-oil/thujone caution remains; chronic safety is unresolved.
